articles.title_en: Slovak Parliament approved the cancellation of the correspondence elections
articles.lead_en: The Slovak parliament approved the abolition of the possibility of voting in parliamentary elections by mail from abroad. Ten months before the scheduled deadline for the next election, the parliament adopted a new electoral law, which the government coalition passed with the support of a part of the non-voting deputies after losing a majority in the National Council.
